claims.claim: Born June 12, 1985, in Livingston, New Jersey
Harvard College BA 2008; Harvard Business School MBA 2011
Bachelor's degree in government from Harvard (2008); co-founded Vostu as an undergraduate; one year at Goldman Sachs; MBA 2011
Thrive Capital founded in 2009 by Joshua Kushner at age 24; seed funding from Joel Cutler of General Catalyst; headquartered in the Puck Building, New York City
Early Thrive investments included Instagram, Spotify, Slack and ClassPass
Thrive investments include GitHub, Twitch, Stripe, Plaid, Airtable, Databricks, Ramp and OpenAI
Goldman Sachs bought a minority stake in Thrive in 2021; Bob Iger, Mukesh Ambani, Henry Kravis and others acquired a stake in January 2023
Thrive Capital led the OpenAI funding round announced October 2, 2024
Oscar Health founded in 2012 in New York City by Mario Schlosser, Kevin Nazemi and Joshua Kushner; health insurance company
Oscar was incorporated October 25, 2012; Kushner and Schlosser sign the S-1 letter as Co-Founders
Oscar reported large losses in 2015 and 2016 when its models failed to forecast member health accurately; positive net income for 2024
Oscar IPO on March 3, 2021, on the NYSE under ticker OSCR
IPO priced at 39 dollars per share; Oscar lost about 400 million dollars in 2020; Kushner held about 76 percent of voting power through Thrive's stake
Mario Schlosser stepped down as CEO in April 2023 and Mark Bertolini became CEO
